name: National Student Education Loan
issuing_authority: Ministry of Education, Government of India
short_description: Central sector education loan scheme offering collateral-free financial assistance up to Rs. 15 Lakhs for students pursuing higher education across all Indian states and Union Territories, featuring full interest subsidy and 1% concession for female students.
benefits: Collateral-free loan up to Rs. 7.5 Lakhs (and up to Rs. 15 Lakhs with joint parent guarantee), full interest subsidy during moratorium period (course duration + 1 year) for families with income up to Rs. 4.5 Lakhs, 1% interest rate discount for female students, and repayment tenures up to 15 years.

eligibility_criteria.applicable_states: All States and Union Territories of India
eligibility_criteria.admission_requirement: Confirmed admission to a recognized higher education degree, diploma, or professional course in an accredited college or university
eligibility_criteria.covered_courses: Engineering (B.Tech/M.Tech), Medicine (MBBS/MD), Management (MBA), Law (LLB/LLM), Pure Sciences, Polytechnic, and other AICTE/UGC/MCI accredited professional programs
eligibility_criteria.collateral_requirement: No collateral or third-party guarantee required for loans up to Rs. 7.5 Lakhs under Central Credit Guarantee Fund Scheme (CGFSEL)
eligibility_criteria.interest_subsidy: 100% full interest subsidy during the moratorium period (course duration + 12 months) for students from families with annual income up to Rs. 4,50,000 under the Central Sector Interest Subsidy (CSIS) scheme; 1% interest rate concession for female applicants
eligibility_criteria.repayment_tenure: Repayment tenure up to 15 years with flexible EMI starting 1 year after course completion
mandatory_rules: Applicant must be an Indian citizen residing in any State or Union Territory.
Applicant age must be between 16 and 35 years at the time of application.
Must have secured admission in an approved higher education course in a recognized college/university.
Must have scored at least 50% marks in the previous qualifying examination.
To be eligible for full government interest subsidy and credit guarantee, annual family income must not exceed Rs. 8,00,000.
Co-borrower (parent or legal guardian) is mandatory.
